Looking-Ahead

Selected code is adapted from Future-Predictive-Video-Diffusion (FPVD).
Migration source revision: 5b2617d59342f295db3be298e7159e64b5603e4f.
Project modifications include public configuration, selected algorithm/data paths,
family geometry, strict checkpoint loading, launch integration and code pruning.
Strict-resume adaptations specialize AdamW/single EMA and public configuration,
use an independent public bundle format, preserve rank-local DCP/RNG/data replay,
and add atomic completion publication and coordinated completed-step retention.
EMA resume restoration validates and reuses rank-owned shadow storage to avoid
redundant GPU copies; the replaced local clone-loader is removed.

Wan2.1 and Wan2.2
Copyright 2024-2025 The Alibaba Wan Team Authors. All rights reserved.
https://github.com/Wan-Video/Wan2.1
https://github.com/Wan-Video/Wan2.2
Apache License, Version 2.0; see third_party/licenses/Apache-2.0.txt.
Applicable source headers remain in the retained modules.

Diffusers scheduler adaptations
https://github.com/huggingface/diffusers
src/wan/utils/fm_solvers.py identifies scheduling_dpmsolver_multistep.py at main;
FPVD did not pin that donor revision. src/wan/utils/fm_solvers_unipc.py identifies
scheduling_unipc_multistep.py at v0.31.0. Wan adapted these to flow matching.
Looking-Ahead retains the selected deterministic order-2 solver paths and fixes
the diffusion timestep scale to 1000. Apache License, Version 2.0.

Transformers T5 adaptation
https://github.com/huggingface/transformers
src/wan/modules/t5.py identifies transformers.models.t5.modeling_t5 as its origin.
The FPVD/Wan donor does not pin that revision. Looking-Ahead retains the encoder
used by the selected Wan interfaces. Apache License, Version 2.0.

FramePack memory helpers
By lllyasviel; https://github.com/lllyasviel/FramePack/tree/main/demo_utils
src/utils/memory.py retains DynamicSwapInstaller and get_cuda_free_memory_gb;
unused convenience functions and import-time CUDA allocation were removed.
Apache License, Version 2.0.

Wan2.2-TI2V-5B-Turbo origin
https://github.com/quanhaol/Wan2.2-TI2V-5B-Turbo
FPVD identifies this origin for src/wan22/modules/model.py. Looking-Ahead retains
only sinusoidal_embedding_1d, rope_params, rope_apply, WanRMSNorm and WanLayerNorm,
with their FPVD numerical behavior and original copyright attribution.
The project maintainer confirmed on 2026-10-05 that these five primitives may be
used in this Apache-2.0 project. This is a maintainer-provided permission basis;
no independent additional upstream grant is represented here, and this statement
does not extend to other Turbo components or assets. The historical upstream
CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0 declaration remains recorded in the migration provenance.

Dependencies and user-acquired model/data assets retain their own terms. This
notice does not assign an asset license to WISA data or generated example images.
